source_pages.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) - 1m
source_pages.fact: ~99% England, 1m bare-earth DTM, EPSG:27700, +/-15cm RMSE, 2022 composite uses surveys through 2022-04-02
source_pages.limit: composite metadata does not prove post-2022 target freshness

source_pages.name: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
source_pages.fact: 25cm/50cm/1m/2m site-specific DTM, GeoTIFF 5km zips, ODN, EPSG:27700, revision 2024-07-19, period to 2024-04-18
source_pages.limit: current metadata page exposes no direct data services/resources; not proof of no data

source_pages.name: National LIDAR Programme
source_pages.fact: 1m England programme with coverage metadata and repeat surveys; programme data period extends into 2023
source_pages.limit: programme-wide period is not parcel-specific lineage

source_pages.name: LIDAR Time Stamped Point Cloud
source_pages.fact: 5km yearly LAZ downloads, coverage metadata WMS/WFS, full GDB/GeoJSON/GPKG/SHP downloads, period to 2024-04-18
source_pages.limit: classified ground points can differ from manually edited final DTM

source_pages.name: LIDAR DSM Time Stamped Tiles
source_pages.fact: 5km GeoTIFF DSM, coverage metadata WMS/WFS and full downloads, revision 2024-07-19
source_pages.limit: DSM includes buildings/vegetation/vehicles and cannot replace bare-earth DTM

source_pages.name: LIDAR Ground Truth Surveys
source_pages.fact: independent control points +/-3cm RMSE; timestamped LIDAR must pass <+/-15cm RMSE and 10cm random-error QC
source_pages.limit: 3cm is control-point accuracy, not parcel DTM accuracy

source_pages.name: Persistent LIDAR WCS guidance
source_pages.fact: persistent DTM1m WCS URL uses WCS 2.0.1 and avoids annual year suffix
source_pages.limit: service availability is not an observed target sample

source_pages.name: LIDAR Composite DSM - 1m
source_pages.fact: 1m surface model includes surface objects and mirrors 2022 composite survey period
source_pages.limit: not suitable as primary bare-earth height source

source_pages.name: LIDAR Composite Catalogues
source_pages.fact: catalogue/index role for full-coverage LIDAR surveys
source_pages.limit: catalogue record has no direct resources and is not numeric elevation

source_pages.name: Retired LIDAR Composite DTM 2017 - 25cm
source_pages.fact: retired composite replaced by 1m product; archive routes to survey download
source_pages.limit: retired 25cm composite must not be promoted as current primary product

source_pages.name: Survey Index WFS endpoint
source_pages.fact: official coverage-metadata WFS endpoint is linked by EA dataset pages
source_pages.limit: current browsing client rejected application/xml parsing; feature type and exact target response remain unobserved

source_pages.name: INSPIRE Index Polygons download
source_pages.fact: July 2026 monthly authority downloads provide indicative registered-freehold index polygons
source_pages.limit: not exact legal boundary or elevation evidence

source_pages.name: INSPIRE technical guidance
source_pages.fact: native British National Grid workflow; reprojection can shift some features materially
source_pages.limit: web-reprojected geometry is not exact native match basis

source_pages.name: Practice guide 40 supplement 3 - boundaries
source_pages.fact: updated 2026-06-01; most titles use general boundaries and no standard tolerance maps title-plan line to legal boundary
source_pages.limit: ordinary title geometry cannot be assigned survey-grade legal precision

source_pages.name: Practice guide 40 supplement 4 - determined boundaries
source_pages.fact: updated 2026-06-01; determined boundary is a separate exact-line register process
source_pages.limit: exactness cannot be assumed without determined-boundary evidence

source_pages.name: Practice guide 40 supplement 5 - title plan
source_pages.fact: updated 2026-07-13; title plans show general extent unless determined and are not routinely updated with each OS map change
source_pages.limit: title plan must be read with register and referenced documents

source_pages.name: Practice guide 40 supplement 1 - basis of plans
source_pages.fact: OS mapping is multi-purpose topographic mapping and is not intended to represent property boundaries
source_pages.limit: map scale/OS accuracy cannot be converted into legal-boundary accuracy

source_pages.name: OS Terrain 50 overview
source_pages.fact: 50m lower-resolution DTM, full GB, annual July update, verified 4m RMSE
source_pages.limit: secondary parcel-scale cross-check only

source_pages.name: OS Terrain 50 grid specification
source_pages.fact: 10km tiles, 200x200 cells, 50m pixels, heights to nearest 0.1m
source_pages.limit: 50m grid cannot replace EA 1m polygon sampling

source_pages.name: OS Downloads API
source_pages.fact: automated OpenData product discovery/download path
source_pages.limit: API availability does not prove target archive was sampled
